notes.title: Update v102 - missed the balloons?
notes.content:
Meow!

You didn't pop all the balloons? You have a hard time getting the balloon achievement?

No problem! Look at the score screen (with the sleeping cat). If all your scores are above zero you'll find a suprise in the top right corner.

notes.title: Update v101 - achievements
notes.content:
Hello Achievement Hunters,

This update should make it impossible to miss an achievement in the future. Sorry to everyone who had trouble unlocking achievements.
